query:
SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS "messages!: u32",
                COALESCE(SUM(mentions_me), 0) AS "mentions!: u32"
            FROM
                message
            WHERE
                chat_id = ?1
                AND sender_user_uuid IS NOT NULL
                AND sender_user_domain IS NOT NULL
                AND (sender_user_uuid != ?3 OR sender_user_domain != ?4)
                AND status != ?2
                AND timestamp >
                (
                    SELECT
                        last_read
                    FROM
                        chat
                    WHERE
                        chat_id = ?1
                )
